mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, author, view_count, created_at, updated_at FROM post ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (title, content, author, view_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{author}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{request.title}, content = #{request.content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
